content.short: MetaCene is a AAA blockchain MMORPG built on Mantle, featuring a post-apocalyptic world with player-driven economy and NFT asset ownership.
content.description: MetaCene is a next-generation massively multiplayer online role-playing game powered by Unreal Engine 5 and built on the Mantle Network. Founded by gaming veterans with 20+ years of experience from studios including Shanda Games, Blizzard, and Perfect World, MetaCene has raised $15M from investors including Mantle EcoFund, Folius Ventures, SevenX Ventures, and Animoca Ventures. The game features a dual-token system ($MUD for in-game utility and $MAK for governance), player-owned NFT assets, and PVE/PVP gameplay with guild DAO governance. MetaCene has onboarded over 27,000 players and 500,000 ecosystem users across its testing phases.
content.meta: MetaCene is a AAA blockchain MMORPG on Mantle with player-driven economy and true NFT ownership. Discover MetaCene on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
